work.title: No More Poor Doors
work.description: Blue-painted billboard surface layered with multiple stickers and paste-ups, including a red panel depicting three white snowmen above a black silhouette figure holding a vertical placard reading 'NO MORE POOR DOORS / CLASS WAR.' Additional stickers read 'CLYDE P' and 'RECORDS'; weathered and partially torn remnants occupy the lower register above a brick wall.
work.composition: central paste-up on blue utility box
